items.title: Deere Down on Earnings; Dell Lower Despite Server Sales | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Deere (DE) shares are lower as it reports earnings this morning, with the focus of investors being on the farm economy and whether it will emerge from a prolonged slump that's pressured sales of tractors and other agricultural equipment. Deere reported earnings per share for the fourth quarter that missed the average analyst estimate. - Dell Technologies (DELL) is lower this morning even after it boosted its fiscal year revenue sales outlook for the third time due to surging server sales fueled by the rapid build-out of AI data centers. - Nvidia (NVDA) and Anthropic (ANT) are lower as the broader AI trade continues to sink after the Jensen Huang-led rally. Anthropic has traded below their $83 initial public offering price for the first time, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab's record-setting debut last week.
